test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 30 Jan 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question: Which among the following statements is incorrect?

options.text: The melting point of ice decreases with decrease in pressure.
Spherical Shape of liquid droplets is due to the property of surface tension in liquids.
Evaporation takes place only on the surface of liquids.
Liquids at high altitudes boil at lower temperature due to low atmospheric pressure at high altitudes.

solution:
The correct answer is** The melting point of ice decreases with decrease in pressure.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The melting point of ice decreases with a decrease in pressure.__

 __
 
• **The statement is incorrect.**
 
• Melting point of ice decreases with increase in pressure because as pressure increases the molecules of ice try to maintain the ratio by decreasing their volume
 
 
 
• Spherical Shape of liquid droplets is due to the property of surface tension in liquids.__
 __
 
• **This statement is correct.**
 
• Surface tension is the tendency of fluid surfaces to shrink into the minimum surface area possible.
 
• Surface tension causes liquid droplets to take up a spherical shape because a sphere has the smallest possible surface area for a given volume.
 
 
 
• **Evaporation can only take place on the surface of liquids because that is where the molecules with the highest kinetic energy are found.** Only molecules with high kinetic energy are free to escape into the atmosphere.
 
• Liquids at high altitudes boil at lower temperature due to low atmospheric pressure at high altitudes.__
 __
 
• **This statement is correct.**
 
• Boiling occurs when a liquid's vapor pressure equals the external pressure.
 
• At high altitudes, the atmospheric pressure is lower, which means liquids can reach their boiling points at lower temperatures.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Surface tension** is the property of liquids that causes them to minimize their surface area, resulting in the formation of spherical droplets.
 
• **Evaporation **is a process in which a liquid changes into a gas or vapor phase, and it occurs when the molecules of the liquid gain enough kinetic energy to overcome the intermolecular forces holding them together.
 
• **Atmospheric pressure** decreases with altitude, and this reduces the boiling point of the liquid, making it easier to boil at lower temperatures.
